fnol_text: My name is Maya Laurent and I live at 459 Primrose Lane, Fairview, PA 16447. You can reach me on (555) 550-9592 or maya.laurent@example.com. On 12 June 2025 the Millbrook River overtopped near our house after a week of storms. River water flooded the downstairs rooms and the garage. Policy HH-2025-00119. I'd like to claim for the damage to my home.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Ms Laurent on (555) 550-9592 to acknowledge the claim. Maya confirmed the loss date as 12 June 2025.
Site visit to 459 Primrose Lane. Neighbour Lucia Oduya was present and confirmed the timeline.
Maya sent photos and a contractor's estimate. Water line visible on walls.
